text: Only one of the storage modes from Lesson 71 actually needs anything in this chapter. Here's which one, and why.
Import mode copies data in, so that copy goes stale. DirectQuery and live connection modes query the source live, every time — there's nothing to catch up.
You can trigger a refresh on a schedule, or right now, on demand. Refresh now doesn't count against your daily scheduled quota.
That quota depends on where the semantic model lives — eight scheduled refreshes a day on shared capacity, up to forty-eight on Premium, PPU, or Fabric capacity.

Refresh only re-imports rows, never structure — rename a column at the source and the service refresh breaks until you republish from Desktop. Lesson 76 covers the gateway that makes on-premises refresh possible at all.
